description: Several AI workers (Claude Code / Codex), each with its own role, working together in one group chat right inside VS Code.
untrusted: AgentRoom runs agents, commands and SSH connections defined by config stored in the repo, so it only works in a workspace you trust.
cmd.measureContext: AgentRoom: Measure fixed context of new sessions (no quota used)
cmd.cleanup: AgentRoom: Clean up junk/temp/cache files (gather, never delete)
cmd.takeOver: AgentRoom: Take over orchestration (when another window is running)
cmd.telegram.setup: AgentRoom: Telegram — set up (bot token, pairing)
cfg.maxAgentHops: Maximum agent→agent turns counted from one user message (loop guard).
cfg.claudePath: Path to the claude CLI (empty = look in PATH).
cfg.codexPath: Path to the codex CLI (empty = look in PATH).
cfg.contextMessages: Number of recent messages put in the prompt each turn.
cfg.memoryBudgetChars: Maximum characters of SOUL + memory + journal put into the persona each turn.
cfg.storage.mode: Storage migration gate. legacy uses files only. verify creates a verified backup and SQLite shadow snapshot, while files remain authoritative.
cfg.inspector.keepTurns: Number of most recent turns kept for the Context Inspector (0 = off). The folder holds code, so it is git-ignored.
cfg.pricing: Price table to estimate Codex cost, USD per 1 million tokens. Example: {"gpt-5.4": {"input": 2.5, "cachedInput": 0.25, "output": 10}}. Models not in the table get no cost.
cfg.telegram.enabled: Turn on the Telegram channel (control and get notifications from your phone). Can only be set in user settings, not in the workspace. The bot token is kept in VS Code's secret storage.
cfg.telegram.detail: summary: a short version of replies (code is shortened). full: full text (goes through Telegram's servers, not end-to-end encrypted). alerts: only alerts, approval cards and messages with @user.
cfg.telegram.approveFromPhone: safe: from the phone, only approve file edits inside the worker's working folder (not .env, .git, CI, keys…). none: the phone can only deny.
cfg.telegram.summaryChars: Maximum characters of the summary sent to the phone.
cfg.telegram.quietHours: Quiet hours, e.g. 22:00-07:00: messages are still sent but without sound or vibration.
cfg.cleanup.turnsOlderThanDays: When running the cleanup command, also suggest turn records (Context Inspector) older than N days. 0 = do not suggest. Only a suggestion; nothing is deleted automatically.
cfg.planUsage.pollMinutes: How often (minutes) to re-read each account's subscription plan limits (Claude/Codex). 0 = only when you press Refresh or after each turn. Reading costs no tokens.
cfg.agentDebounceMs: Wait this many milliseconds before waking a worker because of another worker's message, so messages that arrive together are answered in ONE turn (saves tokens). 0 = wake immediately.
cfg.language: AgentRoom display language (chat, dialogs, notices, Telegram). auto = follow VS Code's language. Command Palette titles always follow VS Code's display language. Prompts sent to the AI stay in Vietnamese.
